title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, and the Company's tariff M.D.P.U. 115, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the months of September, October and November 1991. Application is also made for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 200 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of setions 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regualtory Policies Act of 1978.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Yardley, Jr., Kates-Garnick, Webster (91-4C).
Affidavit of Gail Hatch. By: Cathryn A. Neaves (91-4C).
Fuel Cost Adjustment filing effective September - November 1991. By: Cathryn A. Neaves (91-4C).
Hearing notice issued to be held Wednesday, August 22, 1991 at 10:00 a.m, Saltonstall.
